effect.name: Holomatrix
effect.desc: O Holomatrix II do After Effects (Red Giant Universe): holograma azulado com scan lines, glow, faixas que piscam, estática, fantasma de interferência e separação de cor — mais glitch, TV roll e distorções.
effect.desc-en: After Effects' Holomatrix II (Red Giant Universe): a bluish hologram with scan lines, glow, strobing bands, static, interference ghost and colour separation — plus glitch, TV roll and distortions.
